_readme: The checkpoint's UI pass (Sam, 2026-10-08; .claude/commands/checkpoint.md step 9). Every view a person reads: each COBI tab in index.html's nav and each standalone page a11y.config.js measures. last is the day of the view's last pass, outcome what it found and fixed in a sentence, hold the reason a view is skipped. scripts/ui_pass.py --next picks the view; --record stamps it; --check (CI) fails when a view is missing or unknown.

surfaces.name: Sierra
surfaces.outcome: AA, the 24px targets, focus rings, the keyboard and reduced motion pass at nine widths in all four views (arriving and asking, light and dark); First Light holds (every hex in a :root block, Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 self-hosted, dark on the cpl_theme contract); the chat function and the feedback RPC agree with the COBI surfaces (sierra_surfaces_aligned). Nothing to fix.

surfaces.name: Veteran map
surfaces.outcome: Ported to First Light on Sam's Sheet 55 ruling (S350): tokens in :root only, dark on the cpl_theme contract and followed live inside COBI, the two faces embedded; AA, the 24px floor (pins exempt through the two directories) and the keyboard pass at nine widths, light, dark and embedded. Fixed on the way: COBI's Military Partnerships frame overflowed by 170 to 280px and shrank the stars to 4px; ?embed=1 fills the frame and a marker size floor holds the approved size.

surfaces.name: SkyView
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, targets and the keyboard hold at all 11 routes (Sky by night, Globe, Map, the comprehensive view, the workspace tabs, the outline, the work sheet) and its sweep passes 233 of 233. First Light: 20 raw-hex declarations in the template's component rules. Three were dark failures no route reaches (white on the night canvas's #7DA1D4 at 2.65:1: the member-row hover, Put back's hover, the pressed Night word); they write var(--on-accent) now (6.95:1). The four status chips read role tokens by day and at night, and dark's four chip rules are gone. Wiring: three pass RPCs, shared with COBI's phrase gates.

surfaces.name: Fact Sheet
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S350, #1926): 141 targets under 24px fixed, the action bar no longer pins 200px of a phone, raw hex and injected fallbacks became tokens, the recs toggle's undefined --accent became --cobalt, three toolbar glyphs became words. S352: the page never defined --on-accent, so Ask Sierra on hover and the drawer's Send painted body ink on cobalt at 1.35:1 (#1934, with a guard on any bare var() the page does not define). Then First Light (#1938, Sam: 'Fact Sheet looks great!'): Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 self-hosted, COBI's dark palette screen-only on the cpl_theme contract, seal navy split into fill and ink; print and Save as Word keep Cambria and Calibri. fact-sheet and fact-sheet-dark pass at nine widths.

surfaces.name: Privacy
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, the 24px targets and no sideways scroll held at nine widths; First Light's colors were in place but not its type (system-ui) and it had no dark mode. Now Playfair Display and Source Sans 3, self-hosted from sierra/fonts/, and COBI's dark palette on the cpl_theme contract; light and dark measure clean (privacy-dark is a new a11y target). Wiring: no dataset; Google's consent screen is its one link. Its words still describe the Drive filer, parked 2026-10-08, and stay while that screen links the page.

surfaces.name: Funding model
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S351): AA, focus, the keyboard and the 24px targets hold at nine widths and in My CPL Funding; First Light holds (the engine's tokens, the theme's type). One fault: the Columns menu, hung from its summary's left edge, opened past the viewport where the toolbar sets it right (480 to 561px and 1024px; 53px at 560) and the page scrolled sideways. It now hangs from the right edge when it would pass the viewport and fits that way, placed on render, open and resize (tests/cpl_funding_colmenu_edge.test.js). Wiring: the explainer and COBI's Public view agree row for row (119 rows, defaults; the live config is out of the sandbox's reach); College Briefing calls the same model (college_briefing_funding_sync).

surfaces.name: Dashboard
surfaces.outcome: First pass (S352, #1937): clean in light and dark. Before, 16 and 10 contrast findings, 20 targets under 24px, 9 keyboard-unreachable scrollers, an h1 to h3 skip and 4 controls with no focus ring. The 'How this is calculated' panels read white on white on nine cards (the base CSS assumed a dark card that no longer exists); College Activity's literal hex inks kept their light values in dark; its four filters suppressed their focus rings inline; the trophy and the toolbar's squared operators are gone. Fixed in excel_to_dashboard.py, its College Activity template, kpi_cards.js, college_activity.js and both HTMLs. Wiring: the tab reads no dataset the dependency map names (its sections are generated). First Light: College Activity's and KPI Trends' titles still set Georgia rather than Playfair Display.

surfaces.name: Activities
surfaces.outcome: S354: npm run a11y light and dark was 71 targets under 24px in 7 kinds, 4 light contrast pairs (#888 3.54, #999 2.85, gold ink 1.95, On Track badge 4.47), an h1 to h3 skip, Element Map without a ring; now clean in both themes at 1440 and 390. Controls are underlined words (activity links, CPL Workplan, Element Map, Table / Archive, its glyph removed); gray labels read --text-muted; Stretch words --mustard-text; badge tint 0.15; Activities is the h2. Wiring: the view reads no mapped dataset. Left: raw #888 ink elsewhere in the generator (other tabs), and report_generator.js's Custom Report button is still boxed.

surfaces.name: Team & RACI
surfaces.outcome: First pass on Team & RACI: fixed 36 sub-24px Update targets and every contrast finding in both themes (decorative and undefined inks, the mustard fill used as text, row opacity, a white close mark on a header that turns light in dark mode), made every control an underlined word, gave the sortable headers real column-header semantics, contained the directory's 223px sideways scroll at 390px, and removed the loading placeholder that centered the matrix; edit-mode keyboard access and the Mission Control wiring entry are deferred.

surfaces.name: MAP Users
surfaces.outcome: Seeded signed-in sweep (roster and contact worklist, light and dark) found 28 controls under 24px, the search box's focus ring hidden, two tables pushing the page sideways at 390px, and in the first fix --on-accent on --seal-blue at 1.43:1 in dark; controls became underlined words, emoji labels words, raw hex tokens (--white on --seal-blue), each table a named region scrolling below 560px; all four seeded views pass, guarded by tests/map_users_first_light.test.js.
